_about: The lab's image catalog. ExampleCo builds its serving image from an upstream open-source inference server and pushes it to its own Artifact Registry repository. Every name, digest, date and finding count is a LAB VALUE. Two rules use it. One is ExampleCo's own rebuild rule: rebuild and redeploy at least every 90 days (a company rule, not a Google one). The other is Artifact Analysis's continuous analysis window: Google says it 'continues to scan images and packages as long as they have been pulled within the last 30 days', and after that the results go stale.
